responsibility: Implements the D front end’s symbol visibility and access-control checks. This file decides whether declarations are reachable through `private`, `package`, `protected`, `public`, and `export` protection; walks aggregate inheritance to compute effective member access; handles friend-like same-module/class relationships, package-access rules, and protected lookup from scopes; and reports diagnostics for inaccessible members or packages during semantic name resolution, including overload-list visibility selection via the least restrictive overload.
